profile.description: Alumil Rom Industry S.A. engages in the design and production of architectural aluminium systems in Romania and internationally. The company offers hinged windows and doors systems, sliding windows and doors systems, shutters and rolling shutters systems, bi-folding doors systems, entrance doors, curtain walls and façades systems, office partitions systems, solar shadings systems, claddings systems, atrium and conservatory systems, customized fenestration systems, railings systems, pergolas systems, decking systems, building integrated photovoltaics (BIPV) systems, photovoltaic mounting systems, and noise barriers. It also provides wall cladding systems; building materials comprising various polycarbonate sheets and wood-plastic composites; polycarbonate sheets; aluminium systems for atriums, glass atrium roofs, skylights, and greenhouses; and railing systems. In addition, the company offers accessories, including window and door locks; door hinges; door handles; door mechanisms; other hardware; glass options; and surface treatments. Alumil Rom Industry S.A. was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Bucharest, Romania. Alumil Rom Industry S.A. is a subsidiary of Alumil Aluminium Industry S.A.
